verses.text: Yoxelalxo ol in b'at ex wila''. Yalnhej tas junok ol b'o'ok, yowalil ayokab' chawanh ma oxwanhok testigo ol alanok, ichato chi' ol b'o'ok.

Ayik ix in ek' t'a schaelal, ay jun ix walkan t'ayex. Haxo tiknaik swalb'at junelxo. Wach'chom manh in ayok ek' eyet' ta', palta swalb'ati to a ex ochnak he mul t'a yalanhtaxo yet' ex pax wan yoch he mul tiknaik, ayik ol in k'och junelxo, manhxo ol ex wak'laj niwank'olal. Haton jun tik ix ek' walkan t'ayex.

E gana wal tzeyila' tato a Cristo wan in syamk'ab'ani yik syalan t'ayex. Hato wal yik ol in k'ochok, ol heyilani. Ichato chi' ol nachajel eyu'uj. Yujto a Cristo tik, mantok malaj spoder sch'ox t'ayex, palta niwan spoder yik smunlaj t'a he kal.

Yel toni, ayik ix t'unhb'ajk'e t'a te' kulus, ichato malaj spoder. Palta yuj spoder Dios pitzan tiknaik. Hanhejtona', a in pax tik, ichato malaj in poder, palta yuj spoder Dios pitzan in yet' Cristo, yik hanheja' tzin ek' ex in k'ayb'ej.

Tze cham na'ej wal he b'a junjun ex, yik scheklaji tato yel ayoch Cristo t'a he k'o'ol. Hak'ek prowal he b'a junjun ex. ¿Tom manh eyojtakok to a Jesucristo ayoch t'ayex junjun ex? Palta tato manh ex creyenteok t'a yel, manh ayokoch t'ayex.
Palta in gana snachajel eyu'uj sik'lab'il to a in tik creyente in t'a wal yel.

Tzin lesalwi t'a Dios eyu'uj, yik manh ol he k'ulok junok chukal. Manh tonhejok tzin lesalwi eyu'uj yik scheklajeli to wach' in munlaji. Palta in gana to wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'eyb'al, wach'chom ichato scheklajeli to manh wach'ok in munlajel.
Yujto max yal wajk'olan in b'a yet' jun lolonel yel, haton t'a jun b'aj swak' wip in munlaji.
Yuj chi', wach'chom malaj wach' wochi, palta tzin tzalaji tato he ex tik ay eyelk'ochi. Hanhejtona', ol in lesalwok eyu'uj, yik ol wach' b'o he pensar.

Tzin b'ab'laj tz'ib'ejb'at jun in carta tik t'ayex, yakb'an manto in k'och eyet' ta', yujto malaj in gana te ow ol wutej in b'a t'ayex yuj jun wopisio tik, ayik ol in k'och t'ayex ta'. Ha Kajal Jesús ak'jinak jun wopisio tik, yik swak' he tek'anil. Manh yujok ex wak'an juwokeli ix yak'an t'ayin.

Haxo tiknaik ex wuk'tak ex wanab', ayokab' he tzalajk'olal ta'. Tze wach' b'oan he pensar. Ak'jokab' sniwanil he k'o'ol. Junxonhej okab' tzeyutej he pensar, junk'olalxonhej tzeyutej he b'a ta'. Ha Dios ol och heyet'ok, haton jun tz'ak'an he junk'olal, jun tz'ak'an pax he xajanej he b'a.
Slaj eyak'laj stzatzil he k'o'ol yuj he ch'oxani to tze xajanej he b'a.

Ha heb' creyente smasanil t'a tik, syak'b'at stzatzil he k'o'ol heb'. Cheklajokab' el swach'k'olal Kajal Jesucristo t'ayex, yak'okab' pax swach'k'olal Dios t'ayex. Aokab' Yespíritu Dios tz'och heyet'ok he masanil ta'.
